top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider was missing five of the additional training content courses.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A total of one caregiver and ten children were observed inside the licensed childcare home. The maximum children allowed is seven children based on their age group. The licensed childcare home is out of ratio by three children.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines (26 TAC §747.4403(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has an unlocked trampoline on the premises.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have any records on file.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.
